facts.business: Davin Sons Retail Limited is a retail company listed on the BSE SME platform.
key_risks: Delays in filing statutory forms with the Registrar of Companies, Delhi due to technical issues
Failure to submit financial results for half year ended 30th September 2025 and financial year ended 31st March 2026 within prescribed timelines under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Delay in submission of Integrated Filing with the Stock Exchange
Penalties imposed by BSE Ltd. for non-compliance with listing regulations
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, wherever applicable, and the details of such related party transactions have been properly disclosed in the financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
